card.name: Linking words after device nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words, mostly "of", right after a concrete object noun in instructions or technical descriptions, such as "pin of", "armour of", "valve between". Also a few others like "until" or "minutes" in a range.

modes.label: "of" after an object
modes.description: The word "of" follows a physical part or equipment noun and introduces what it belongs to or is made of.
modes.example: Insert piercing pin<< of>> administration set into port with a twisting motion

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like "until" or "between" follow an instruction or equipment phrase and introduce a position or endpoint.
modes.example: into the shielded pump and include a 3-way stopcock valve<< between>> the syringe and an intravenous cath
